description_lines: Redevelopment Site/Condo Titled Hotel & Convention Centre:
6 & 2 storey; 224,890 sf (353 rooms) on about 5.4 Ac
The property is known as the Toronto Don Valley Hotel and Suites.
According to a CBRE Ltd marketing brochure:
In 2015, the property received approval from the City of Toronto for a rezoning amendment to permit the redevelopment of portions of the existing hotel into two new, high-density residential towers.

In 2018, a site plan application was submitted that proposed a total of 755 residential units, within a 32 and 39 storey tower. The total residential GFA for the proposed two towers is approximately 553,394 sq. ft.
The location of Tower 1 is on the existing convention centre and the lobby located to the south of the six storey hotel and Tower 2 is proposed to be built on the existing surface parking lot.

There are 767 total parking spaces with 653 residential parking spaces (includes the 28 underground Hotel spaces and 150 spaces as per the Accolade Easement Agreement), 113 residential visitor parking spaces and one daycare facility parking space.
As per the vendor, the site plan application is expected to be approved in 2020.
